galleryLAB now keeps itself up to date, right where you installed it.

## Download

- **galleryLAB-0.1.1-setup.exe** installs galleryLAB for your Windows account (no administrator rights
  needed). If galleryLAB is already installed, it installs over it in the same folder.
- **galleryLAB-0.1.1-portable.exe** runs without installing. Keep it anywhere, for example on a USB drive.

Requires Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. This build isn't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may say it
“protected your PC”. Choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists each file's SHA-256.

**Coming from 0.1.0?** 0.1.0 can't update itself, so install 0.1.1 once by hand. Run the setup and it
installs into the same folder as before. Your Library and settings stay as they are. From here on, updates
arrive on their own.

## What's new

- **Automatic updates.** galleryLAB checks for a new version shortly after it starts and every few hours.
  It downloads the update in the background and installs it when you quit, or right away with
  **Restart to update**.
- **Your files stay where they are.** The installed app updates in the folder you installed it to,
  including a folder you chose yourself. The portable exe replaces itself at the same path, so shortcuts
  and pins keep working. Your Library and settings are never moved or changed by an update.
- **Checked before it's installed.** Every update is verified against the checksum published with the
  release before anything is replaced. If the download is incomplete or doesn't match, nothing changes.
- **Settings → Updates** shows what's happening and has **Check for updates**. To choose when to
  download, turn off **Update automatically**; galleryLAB then checks only when you ask.

If the portable exe sits in a folder you can't write to, it can't replace itself. Settings tells you so
and links to the releases page.
